R701.why: SW_VDD series resistor (10R) of U701. No layer carries 3V3 within reach of U701, so it stands on the plane here, 70 mm from the switch; the 470 nF C703 stays at the pin and the SW_VDD track adds about 0.2 ohm to the 10 ohm

R607.why: NTC pull-up of output cell 1 (RT601 stays in the cell). On the 3V3 plane south of U401, one via; the NTC line runs to U401 anyway

C607.why: NTC filter capacitor of cell 1, beside R607 at the ADC end of the line

R707.why: NTC pull-up of output cell 2, as R607

C707.why: NTC filter capacitor of cell 2, beside R707

R807.why: NTC pull-up of output cell 3, as R607

C807.why: NTC filter capacitor of cell 3, beside R807

R508.why: T1S_IRQ_L pull-up, 3.3 mm from ball B3 on the line from U501 pin 22 (was under the GND busbar, 14 mm off that line)
